summary.text: Shayne Morgan is the independent candidate for the Montana House of Representatives, District 76, in the November 3, 2026 general election against Republican Trish Schreiber; there is no incumbent in the race.
He lists his profession as business owner and president.

paragraphs.text: Shayne Morgan said in a Ballotpedia survey that he was born and raised in Butte, graduated from Butte High School in 1990 and attended Montana Tech and Carroll College.
He said he began his career in radio while still in high school, later worked in newspapers and television, and became a publisher who launched his own paper, The Valley Explorer.
He said he then spent eight seasons as a wildland firefighting contractor in the Pacific Northwest and later moved into coding and cybersecurity.
Morgan is running as an independent for District 76.
In the survey he named rural healthcare access, strong public education and support for ballot initiative I-194, the Montana Plan, among his key messages.
